visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a group of five people in a living room; a man in a brown shirt holds the camera in a selfie view while smiling, while an older man in black, a woman in red, a baby, and a young girl sit on a couch behind him. (2) The camera pans across a bookshelf containing framed family photos and decorative items, showing the interior of the new home. (3) A woman in a red jacket holds a baby while sitting next to an older man on the couch; they are gesturing peace signs. (4) A young girl in a red plaid dress drinks from a red mug with a concentrated expression. (5) The scene shifts to a kitchen counter where the PurVive-4H2 filtration system box and its components are showcased. (6) A technician in a black and blue uniform is shown working inside a white cabinet under the kitchen sink. (7) Close-up shots highlight the metallic finish of the filtration unit and the brand logo. (8) The mother in the red jacket uses the new tap to wash green lettuce leaves, with clear water flowing over them. (9) The main female creator, wearing a purple sweater, fills a red mug with water from the dedicated tap. (10) The little girl is shown again drinking from the mug, then laughing and looking up at the camera. (11) The technician is seen explaining something while pointing to the installation under the sink. (12) The video concludes with the daughter and her mother standing together in the kitchen, both giving a double thumbs-up and smiling broadly.

It combines emotional family moments with detailed technical explanations and a showcase of the professional installation service to appeal to health-conscious family viewers.
